blocks.text: Acute pulmonary oedema (APO) is a medical emergency characterised by the rapid accumulation of fluid within the pulmonary interstitium and alveolar spaces, resulting in impaired gas exchange, reduced lung compliance and potentially life-threatening respiratory failure.
It commonly occurs due to acute elevation of pulmonary capillary hydrostatic pressure secondary to left ventricular dysfunction.
However, pulmonary oedema can also occur through increased alveolar-capillary permeability, even when cardiac filling pressures are normal.

blocks.text: Acute pulmonary oedema is a medical emergency. Management should begin immediately while investigations are being organised.
Initial management

items.text: Position the patient upright (high Fowler's position), with legs dependent if tolerated.
Establish continuous ECG, BP and SpO₂ monitoring.
Commence CPAP or BiPAP early when respiratory distress and hypoxaemia warrant it.
Give IV loop diuretic if there is fluid overload.
Give IV nitrates if blood pressure permits, particularly in hypertensive pulmonary oedema.
Identify and treat the precipitating cause.
Arrange admission to an appropriate monitored unit.

subsections.subsection_title: 9. Adverse effects, complications and toxicity management

blocks.text: A. Furosemide-induced hypokalaemia

items.text: Assess ECG if hypokalaemia is significant.
Replace potassium according to the severity and route required.

blocks.text: B. Diuretic-associated acute kidney injury

items.text: Stop other nephrotoxic medicines where appropriate.
Monitor urine output and renal function.
Distinguish haemodynamic creatinine changes during successful decongestion from progressive renal injury.

blocks.text: C. GTN-induced hypotension

items.text: Consider cautious fluid administration only if volume depletion is present.

blocks.text: D. Norepinephrine extravasation

items.text: Stop infusion through the affected line.
Consider local phentolamine infiltration where available and appropriate.

blocks.text: E. Dobutamine-induced arrhythmia

items.text: Treat the arrhythmia according to the relevant resuscitation protocol.
